46322.subject: Mathematics
46322.question_text: What is the next number in the series 2, 1, \(\frac{1}{2}\), \(\frac{1}{4}\)...
46322.explanation:
2, 1, \(\frac{1}{2}\), \(\frac{1}{4}\).....

There are 4 terms in the series
Therefore the next number will be the 5th term

Tn = ar\(^{n − 1}\) (formular for geometric series)

a = first term = 2

r = common rate = \(\frac{\text{next term}}{\text{previous term}}\) = \(\frac{1}{2}\)

n = number of terms

T5 = 5th term = ?

T5 = ar\(^{5 - 1}\)

= ar\(^4\)

= 2 × (ar\(^{n − 1}\))4

= 2 × \(\frac{1}{16}\)

= \(\frac{1}{8}\)

46325.question_text: If two graphs Y = px<sup>2</sup>  + q and y = 2x<sup>2</sup>  − 1 intersect at x =2, find the value of p in terms of q

Y = 2x2 - 1

p = \(\frac{2x^2 - 1 - q}{x^2}\)

at x = 2

= \(\frac{2(4) - 1 -q}{4}\)

= \(\frac{8 - 1 - q}{4}\)

P = \(\frac{7 - q}{4}\)

46349.subject: Mathematics
46349.question_text: Find the principal which amounts to ₦ 5,500 at a simple interest in 5 years at 2% per annum
46349.explanation:
Principal = P, Simple Interest = I, Amount = A

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

I = \(\frac{PRT}{100}\)

R = rate, T = time

I = \(\frac{P \times 5 \times 2}{100}\)

I = \(\frac{10P}{100}\)

I = \(\frac{P}{10}\)

Amount A = P + I

5500 = P + \(\frac{P}{10}\)

Multiply through by 100

5500 = 10P + P

5500 = 11P

p = \(\frac{5500}{11}\)

p = ₦5000

= ₦ 80,000

= \(\frac{90}{360}\) × 80,000

46355.question_text: Find the equation of the locus of a point p (x, y) such that pv = pw, where v= (1, 1) and w = (3, 5)
46355.explanation:
The locus of a point p(x, y) such that pv = pw where v = (1, 1)

and w = (3, 5). This means that the point p moves so that its distance from v and w are equidistance

\(\sqrt{(x − x_1)^2 + (y − y_1)^2}\) = \(\sqrt{(x − x_2)^2 + (y − y_2)^2}\)

\(\sqrt{(x -1)^2 + (y - 1)^2}\) = \(\sqrt{(x - 3)^2 + (y - 5)^2}\)

square both sides
(x - 1)2 + (y - 1)2 = (x - 3)2 + (y - 5)2

x2 - 2x + 1 + y2 - 2y + 1 = x2 - 6x + 9 + y2 - 10y + 25

x2 + y2 -2x -2y + 2 = x2 + y2 - 6x - 10y + 34

Collecting like terms
x2 - x2 + y2 - y2 - 2x + 6x -2y + 10y = 34 - 2

4x + 8y = 32

Divide through by 4

x + 2y = 8
